Extremely Disappointing and Unprofessional - Avoid at All Costs

I am writing this review to warn others after an absolutely terrible experience with Hangers.

They ruined a brand-new shirt of mine that had never been worn even once. It was given for dry cleaning in August and returned sealed in their plastic packaging, which remained completely unopened until the day the issue was discovered. Despite being unused and sealed, the shirt had visible marks all over it when opened. Photos have been attached for reference.

What makes this worse - and frankly ironic - is that the lady at the counter initially denied that the shirt was even cleaned at their laundry, until we pointed out their own laundry’s name printed on the packaging tag. Only then did she stop denying it. The level of accountability here was shocking.

They also lost a pant worth ₹1200 and offered compensation of only ₹300, which is completely unacceptable.

In addition, they ruined a limited-edition jacket that was very dear to me by leaving black stains on the white portions, causing irreversible damage.

As if that wasn’t enough, they also spoiled a one-time worn kurta. When I pointed out a black mark on a maroon kurta - which was not present when it was given for dry cleaning - the staff claimed it was due to the kurta’s own color. This explanation is absurd, as the kurta does not contain a single shade of black.

The lady at the counter was extremely rude and refused to accept responsibility. She even blamed me, saying the shirt got ruined because it was “just sitting in the cupboard,” despite it being sealed and unopened since cleaning. Only after the discussion escalated did she offer to re-clean the clothes, and even then, it was presented as a favor rather than a correction of their mistake. The gentleman ironing clothes was equally rude and unwilling to accept fault.

After we left the shop with our ruined clothes, her son called my mother, falsely accusing us of not paying and being rude, instead of addressing the actual issue.

This place used to be decent, and we were long-time customers. However, if this is how mistakes are handled—by denial, blame-shifting, and disrespect - I strongly recommend that no one visit this laundry.

Edit: Response to the reply

Sir, thank you for your response. However, several claims made by you are factually incorrect.

The shirt was brand new and never worn, making the claim of “pre-existing stains” or “wear marks” impossible. The packet was not opened even once until the issue was raised. The damage was discovered immediately upon opening the sealed package.

Similarly, the kurta and jacket did not have black marks when handed over. These appeared after your service. When clothes are given without stains, the reasonable expectation is that they will be returned clean- or at the very least, not in worse condition.

The concern was not raised “after four months” in the manner you imply. The garments were sealed and unused, and the issue was raised as soon as the damage was discovered. Time is irrelevant when the clothes were never handled or worn.

The so-called “goodwill gesture” was offered only after repeated denial and escalation. Prior to that, responsibility was repeatedly deflected and blamed on us.

Finally, losing an item worth ₹1200 and offering ₹300 as compensation may be your policy, but it does not come across as fair or reasonable.

I am merely placing the facts on record. Based on this experience, my original review remains unchanged.
